ex.en: Have you had your flu vaccination this year?
ex.zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了嗎？

ex.en: Vaccination is free for children under six.
ex.zh: 六歲以下兒童可以免費接種疫苗。

ex.en: Every Tuesday morning the housekeeper vacuums.
ex.zh: 每週二早上，管家都會用吸塵器打掃。

ex.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
ex.zh: 這台吸塵器是我免費拿到的。

ex.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 我用吸塵器把地上的灰塵吸乾淨。

ex.en: Sound cannot travel in a vacuum.
ex.zh: 聲音無法在真空中傳播。

ex.en: The coffee is sealed in a vacuum pack.
Sorry, we have no vacancies tonight.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我們今晚沒有空房。

ex.en: The sign outside the motel said "Vacancy."
ex.zh: 汽車旅館外面的招牌寫著「有空房」。

ex.en: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
We advertised the vacancy online last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週在網路上刊登了這個職缺。

ex.en: We gave our car keys to the valet.
ex.zh: 我們把車鑰匙交給代客停車的人員。

ex.en: Valet parking costs 20 dollars a night.
ex.zh: 代客停車一晚 20 美元。

ex.en: This passport is valid for five years.
ex.zh: 這本護照的有效期是五年。

ex.en: This ticket is valid for three days.
The special conditions will be valid until 2025.
ex.zh: 此特殊條件有效期限至 2025 年。

ex.en: She had a valid reason for being late.
